questions.q: What system becomes 60% more active during sleep to clear brain waste?
questions.why: The glymphatic system is noted as 60% more active during sleep.

questions.q: Which toxin linked to Alzheimer's is cleared more efficiently when sleeping?
questions.why: Amyloid‑beta is the toxin removed by the glymphatic system during sleep.

questions.q: What hormone is produced when eyes detect darkness, promoting sleep?
questions.why: Darkness triggers melatonin production, making you sleepy.

questions.q: How is insomnia primarily characterized in the book?
a: Inability to fall asleep at all
questions.why: Insomnia is described as frustration about unsatisfactory sleep, not total inability.

questions.q: What is the first step in improving sleep hygiene according to the author?
questions.why: Preparation of the environment is identified as the first step for sleep hygiene.
